promptText: LOCAL LOWER-BODY EDIT of image1 only: exact same alchemy boy, original full-canvas framing. Freeze the head/hair/face/neck, torso ABOVE BELT, both arms/hands and held props, bag/scrolls/ribbons/robe silhouette at original size and positions. Do not enlarge/recenter or move the full character. Camera is SOUTHWEST toward screen lower-left, three-quarter front camera. BOTH boot long axes stay aligned SOUTHWEST, ivory toe toward screen lower-left and heel behind/upper-right. Front-to-back support progression goes from lower-left through below pelvis toward upper-right, NOT an outward hip/knee swing. Keep the advancing leg in this single stride plane and avoid the previous07-to08 sideways jump. Image2 is this same boy's correct supporting-foot mechanics reference ONLY: use its planted ankle/sole and weight-bearing relationship, not its head pose or entire figure. Image3 is approved painting/material style only, no UI. This frame has anatomical LEFT as the ONLY grounded WEIGHT-BEARING SUPPORT foot; anatomical RIGHT is the raised recovering/swing foot. FIRST drawing of SLIGHTLY-BEHIND-BODY SUPPORT pair. Same support leg now passes just behind the pelvis as body advances; move it back along direction of travel in depth, NOT sideways. Keep sole still substantially flat, heel can begin a SMALL roll but toe and forefoot remain visibly pressed onto ground. Knee naturally flexed/soft, body weight clearly supported through hip-knee-ankle. Opposite leg has passed forward with bent knee and lifted foot. Redraw both legs below the belt as necessary for correct connections, retaining exact original ivory baggy pants, jade-gold floral boots, and proportions. Keep every support contact readable from a flattened contacting sole/forefoot, natural knee flex, and hip-to-ankle load path. Moving foot back is a new drawn anatomical pose, never a cutout translation or warp. No added floor/shadow/ground marks are needed. At every frame at least one foot is clearly grounded. Keep the support toe at the correct projected ground plane matching reference2 and scene perspective; do not raise it to fake stance or plant a hovering shoe. Preserve the original target head/body scale and safe canvas margins; front planted soles near original ground level, rear ground contact follows modest perspective depth. Original RIGHT hand bronze cauldron and LEFT hand green bottle remain exactly unchanged, no new accessories, no mirror, no swapped limbs. Deliver ONE native1254x1254 RGBA transparent sprite with original1024 framing proportionally preserved, clean alpha, no background/text, original bright orange/jade/ivory/gold detailed Chinese chibi painting.
